# multinomial-tv-conjecture

> Complete Lean 4.35.0 formal proof (replayed in six checker runs of `lake comparator --paranoid`), independent exact/80-digit Python verification, interactive Blueprint, and AMS-LaTeX preprint resolving Conjecture 7.7 and quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3 of Banić & Elezović (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, 2026, unrefereed arXiv v1 preprint) on the second-order variance constant of multinomial discrete total variation (`a_triangle = 1/32 - 4*sqrt(3)/243`).

Author: Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648).
License: Apache-2.0 (code/Lean) · CC-BY-4.0 (paper/docs).

## Key Entry Points
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, Quickstart, `#print axioms` excerpt (25 of 59 lines + summary), and comparator verification summary.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions, workflow rules, and verification invariants.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Numbered claims ledger with explicit falsification criteria.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Formal verification boundary and real-vs-metaphor disclosures.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Step-by-step clean-clone reproduction protocol and log.
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Line-by-line mapping from Lean declarations to Banić & Elezović (2026).
- [formalization.yaml](formalization.yaml): Palomar-compatible provenance, toolchain, and AI disclosure metadata.

## Lean 4 Formalization
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Isolated Mathlib-only specification of the 10 target theorems (164 lines, incl. quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3 & literal Part 2 §7.2 $\gamma(3; N)$).
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Sorry-free proofs checked against `Challenge.lean` in six comparator checker runs (+ live negative `sorry`-tamper check).
- [lean/VerifyAxioms.lean](lean/VerifyAxioms.lean): Exhaustive `Lean.collectAxioms` metaprogram (`191` author-written theorems and lemmas; `896` audited theorem constants + `65` definitions) and 59 explicit `#print axioms`.
- [lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/Main.lean](lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/Main.lean): Main proof of `conjecture_7_7`, `lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`, and the five algebraic identities `gamma_closed_form`, `gamma_cyclic_closed_form`, `gamma3_closed_form`, `gamma3_source_form`, `gamma4_closed_form`.
- [lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/NonVacuity.lean](lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/NonVacuity.lean): 22 theorems (6 direct `hAdj 0..5` definition checks + 16 sign, witness, and false-constant/non-degeneracy refutation corollaries covering all 10 targets, independently replayed via `leanchecker`).

## Paper, Scripts & Docs
- [paper/main.tex](paper/main.tex): Complete AMS-LaTeX preprint (v2.7.1).
- [blueprint/src/content.tex](blueprint/src/content.tex): Lean 4 theorem dependency Blueprint source.
- [scripts/verify_conjecture.py](scripts/verify_conjecture.py): Independent exact rational and 80-digit `mpmath` verification.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Proof and verification architecture.
- [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md): Lean kernel, six-run comparator, code-mutation, and Python test-ladder audit specification.
- [docs/reviews/red-team-2026-11-25.md](docs/reviews/red-team-2026-11-25.md): Complete multi-cycle, 10-class hardening audit log.
